skill.name: implement
skill.description: Guides an AI agent through implementing work from a PRD or issue list with tests, review, and a final commit.
skill.summary: Turns a PRD or issue list into a tested implementation workflow.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. I found no semantic prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable behavior in SKILL.md.

content.user_title: Implement PRDs and Issues with Tests
content.value_statement: Turning a PRD or issue list into shipped code requires disciplined execution. This skill guides implementation with test-first work, regular checks, review, and a final commit.
actual_capabilities: Guides implementation from a user-provided PRD or issue list.
Encourages test-driven development where suitable seams are agreed.
Directs the agent to run typechecking during implementation.
Directs targeted tests during work and the full suite at the end.
Uses a code review step before committing work to the current branch.
limitations: Requires a clear PRD, issue list, or acceptance criteria from the user.
Does not define product requirements or resolve unclear scope alone.
Depends on the project having usable typecheck and test commands.
The commit instruction may need adjustment for protected branch workflows.

use_cases.title: Feature Delivery
use_cases.description: Convert a product requirement into a scoped implementation with tests, checks, review, and a commit.

use_cases.title: Issue Backlog Execution
use_cases.description: Work through a defined issue with regular verification and a final review pass.

use_cases.title: Structured Refactor Work
use_cases.description: Apply a documented refactor plan while keeping changes testable and reviewed before commit.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Small Issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for one clear issue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to implement the issue below. Keep changes scoped, run targeted tests, and commit the result. Issue: [paste issue].

prompt_templates.title: Build from a PRD
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a product requirement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the PRD below. Confirm the scope, use TDD where practical, run typechecking, run tests, review the work, and commit it.

prompt_templates.title: Implement with TDD Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement this change using TDD at these agreed seams: [list seams]. Run single test files often and the full suite before committing.

prompt_templates.title: Deliver a Multi-Part Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a larger scoped change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the linked issues as one focused branch. Sequence the work, verify each part, run final review, and commit the completed implementation.

output_examples.input: A product engineer provides a PRD for a new settings option.
output_examples.output: The agent identifies the implementation scope, adds tests around the behavior, updates the application, runs checks, reviews the result, and commits.

output_examples.input: A maintainer asks the agent to resolve a documented bug issue.
output_examples.output: The agent follows the issue, adds a regression test, fixes the bug, runs targeted and full verification, then prepares a focused commit.

output_examples.input: An engineering lead provides a refactor plan with agreed test seams.
output_examples.output: The agent works through the plan in small verified steps, uses TDD where useful, reviews the changes, and commits the finished branch.

best_practices: Provide clear acceptance criteria before starting implementation.
Agree on TDD seams before asking for test-first work.
Run the full test suite before accepting the final commit.
anti_patterns: Using the skill with a vague goal and no success criteria.
Skipping the final review or full test suite on risky changes.
Bundling unrelated PRDs or issues into one implementation request.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: It guides the AI agent to implement code changes from a PRD or issue list.

faq.question: Does it require TDD?
faq.answer: It recommends TDD where practical and where the user agrees on useful seams.

faq.question: Will it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to run typechecking, targeted tests, and the full suite when available.

faq.question: Does it create a commit?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the agent to commit completed work to the current branch.

faq.question: Can it handle unclear requirements?
faq.answer: It works best with clear requirements. Ambiguous PRDs should be clarified before implementation begins.

faq.question: Is it safe to publish?
faq.answer: The skill is prompt-only and no suspicious behavior was found during this audit.
